faq.description: Everything you need to know about King Template. Can't find the answer you're looking for? Contact our support team.

changePlan.q: Can I change my plan later?
changePlan.a: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade anytime. Changes apply to your next billing cycle. We make it easy to adjust as your needs evolve.

paymentMethods.q: What payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.a: All major cards via Stripe including Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and more. You can also manage invoices and subscriptions from the customer portal.

refunds.a: For paid plans, we offer a 14-day money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied, contact support and we'll process your refund - no questions asked.

production.a: Absolutely. It's designed with production patterns: server-first routing, protected pages, Stripe webhooks, secure authentication, and a scalable data model.

selfHost.a: Yes. Deploy on Vercel, Railway, a VPS, or any Node platform that supports Next.js and your database of choice (PostgreSQL recommended).

support.a: Yes! Free plan users get community support via GitHub Discussions. Paid plans include email support with faster response times.
